list: The official 55 trophies, as listed before launch (Exophase and PSNProfiles, agreeing on every name, description and grade)

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work through this ledger stage by stage — story first, then side strands, then collectibles, activities and cleanup — and it will unlock on its own. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.tip: No separate task: earn the other 54 and this unlocks automatically.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end. It is the first mission of the story, so it cannot be missed — just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete screen appears. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.tip: Unmissable: finish the first story mission.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically as the story advances, so keep playing the gold story markers on the map in order and this will pop at the chapter's end. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.tip: Unmissable: complete Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks on its own as the story moves on — follow the story markers and do not worry about skipping anything, since chapter completion has no alternate path. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.tip: Unmissable: complete Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By now the pattern is set: chapter trophies are automatic story progress, so the only work is playing the missions through to the chapter's closing scene. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.tip: Unmissable: complete Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it unlocks the same automatic way as the others — complete the chapter's missions and the trophy follows. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.tip: Unmissable: complete Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Play the final mission to its end. This is the gold story trophy, so it marks the end of the main story rather than a side task — finish the last mission and it pops. If you are chasing missables, do the flagged one-time moments before starting the finale. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.tip: Gold story trophy: finish the final mission — do flagged one-time moments first.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies unlock when that mission's objectives are done, so play it through from its story marker like any other mission. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.tip: Complete the Breakfast Run mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually have a setup phase first, so make sure you finish the setups the game offers before the heist itself — the trophy is for the heist mission, not the setups. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.tip: Finish the heist mission itself, setups included.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks like the other named-mission trophies: reach it in the story, play it through, and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.tip: Complete the Child's Play mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Follow the mission's objectives from its story marker; there is no extra condition beyond finishing the mission. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.tip: Complete the Headliners mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The name points at the Vice City airport, so expect vehicle and on-foot action around VCIA — just play the mission through to completion. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.tip: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the named-mission trophies, so by the time you reach it you will have the pattern down: follow the marker, finish the objectives, collect the trophy. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.tip: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. That checklist is the sum of the story, side strands, collectibles and activities in this ledger — it is the gold trophy that the whole roadmap is built to earn, so treat the roadmap's five stages as the checklist and this pops at the end of stage 5. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.tip: Gold: the whole roadmap in one trophy — 100% completion.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long air time and similar driving feats — across free roam and missions. The count is cumulative, so it builds up naturally while you drive everywhere for other trophies; if it lags near the end, chain jumps off ramps and long straight roads. PSN tracks the count toward 250. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.tip: Cumulative: 250 stunts — drive boldly everywhere and it adds up.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once each. You do not need to win or master any of them — one attempt at each type is enough, so visit each activity's location, start it, and move on. Use the activity list in this ledger to tick them off as you sample them. PSN tracks the count toward 9. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.tip: Sample all 9 activity types once — no win needed.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the grind trophy of the set: every challenge needs a gold score, so practice the weapon types you are weakest with first and replay challenges until each one shows gold. PSN tracks the count toward 42. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.tip: Silver grind: gold in all 42 range challenges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win at every one rather than 14 wins anywhere — visit each drone-race spot on the map and win its race. PSN tracks the count toward 14. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.tip: Win one drone race at each of the 14 locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: the same race won twice counts once, so spread your wins across race types and locations — street, off-road, boat and air races all help toward the 20. PSN tracks the count toward 20. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.tip: Win 20 different races — repeats do not count.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, then out-fish him — steady reeling and watching the line tension matters more than speed. If you lose, the challenge can be retried, so keep at it. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.tip: Beat Cal at fishing — retry if you lose.

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to end. Any arcade cabinet counts — pick the game you find easiest, play it through to its end screen, and the trophy pops. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.tip: Finish any one arcade game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Side strands unlock as the story opens up new contacts — keep taking Andy's missions whenever his marker appears until the strand's last mission completes. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.tip: Finish Andy's whole mission strand.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Like the other contact strands, it is a chain — each mission unlocks the next, so keep answering Kenton's calls and markers until the final one is done. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.tip: Finish Kenton's whole mission strand.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Billy's strand is the rider-themed chain — follow his missions in order until the last one completes. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.tip: Finish Billy's whole mission strand.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question-mark markers on the map — start each strand, play it through, and move on to the next stranger. There are more than 8 strangers, so you can pick the ones you enjoy. PSN tracks the count toward 8. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.tip: Silver: finish any 8 stranger strands.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Keep taking Randy's missions as they appear until the strand ends — the trophy is for the final mission, not for starting the chain. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.tip: Finish Randy's whole mission strand.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Tyrone's chain ends with this trophy, so follow his markers until the last mission's complete screen. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.tip: Finish Tyrone's whole mission strand.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are spread over the whole map, so this pairs well with exploring every area — visit each scenic spot, use the meditate prompt, and tick it off. PSN tracks the count toward 18. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.tip: Meditate at all 18 spots — pair with map exploration.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunt is a tracking job: follow the clues he gives to the animal's area, track it, and take it down cleanly. The trophy is for that one special animal, not general hunting. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.tip: Hunt Bret's one unique animal.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — shops, interiors and out-of-the-way spots — so sweep each area as you explore and keep a set checklist. You need three whole sets, not just any cards. PSN tracks the count toward 3. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.tip: Silver: complete 3 whole card sets.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. This is a volume collectible: the in-game WAiNK It prompt appears at photo-worthy spots, so use it whenever it appears while you explore — the count builds fast if you do it on the go instead of saving it for the end. PSN tracks the count toward 100. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.tip: Silver: WAiNK It at 100 spots — do it as you explore.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the game's small goals — driving, combat, exploration and activity feats — and they stack across everything you do, so this usually pops on its own during a full playthrough. Check the challenge list in-game to see which are closest. PSN tracks the count toward 50. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.tip: Complete any 50 challenges — they stack as you play.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it while a partner is available in free roam — cause trouble in a quiet area, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. Flagged missable because it needs your partner present: do it the first chance you get with a partner alongside. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.tip: Missable — needs your partner: 4 stars, then escape together.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Pick three shops close together, plan a fast route between them, and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies — speed matters more than the take. Flagged missable because it needs your partner present. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.tip: Missable — needs your partner: 3 shops in a row, wanted level kept.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting into a new vehicle model for the first time counts toward the total, so drive everything you see — traffic, parked cars, boats and bikes all add to the list. It builds steadily as you explore. PSN tracks the count toward 100. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.tip: Drive 100 different vehicles — hop into everything new.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies group together — a gang hangout or a wanted-level shootout — then trigger Combat Focus and work through five targets before it ends. If you run out of targets, retry in a busier spot. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.tip: 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus — pick a crowded fight.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave the Vice City airport (VCIA) in an unscheduled way — grab a plane and take off without following the normal departure. Flagged missable because it is tied to one place and one kind of moment: do it the first time you are at the airport with a plane available, rather than assuming you can come back to it later. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.tip: Missable — one airport moment: take off unscheduled at VCIA.

trophies.guide: Do something notable with the Rhino tanks — the description is a joke about how hot it gets inside them. Expect a combat moment involving Rhinos: steal one, survive in one, or take one down, and the trophy should pop when the tank moment is done. This is the vaguest description on the list, so treat it as a fun surprise rather than a planned grind. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.tip: Tank moment: get into the Rhino action and see what pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected. Go in quiet: move slowly, stay out of sight lines, take the goods and leave before any alarm or witness spots you. If you are seen, the attempt fails — leave, reset, and try again with a quieter approach. Flagged missable because a detected attempt can close the clean window for that store. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.tip: Missable — stay unseen the whole robbery, or retry clean.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big robberies: plan the entry, grab the cash, and get clear before the response arrives. Each vault counts once you escape, so five successful vault jobs earn the silver. PSN tracks the count toward 5. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.tip: Silver: rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the map — stop one, crack it open, take the cash and get away before the cops close in. One clean escape is all it takes. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.tip: Rob one armored truck and escape.

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so this is a touring trophy: drive the highways, cross the bridges, and sweep the countryside until every named area is visited. It pairs naturally with the meditation spots and WAiNK It locations. PSN tracks the count toward 52. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.tip: Visit all 52 areas — tour the whole map.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs run their own operations around the map, so you need one hit per gang — not nine hits on the same gang. Work through the gang list and mark each one off as its operation is robbed. PSN tracks the count toward 9. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.tip: Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront bars on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view — the trophy pops when the drink and the view come together. It is a quiet moment trophy, so do it whenever you are passing the beach. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.tip: Cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style — drive straight through the glass. Flagged missable because it reads like a one-time scripted moment inside a showroom: when you find yourself in a showroom with a car, drive it out through the front instead of walking away. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.tip: Missable — drive out through the showroom glass.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a frame properly from the approach to the release. The alley is a named location, so head there, start a game, and finish at least one full follow-through. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.tip: Bowl a full follow-through at Kolt & Associates.

trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal — the description points at doing something with your partner that the public notices. Play the partner missions and free-roam moments together, and this should pop when a partnership beat lands. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.tip: A partner moment with mass appeal — play partner content.

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count toward 500. The game counts the small decisions you make across the story and free roam, so this builds as you play and make calls rather than standing still. There is no single trick: keep playing, keep choosing, and the count climbs. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.tip: Choices add up — PSN counts toward 500.

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try at something you failed first — the description is a wink at retrying. Fail a challenge, mission beat or minigame once, then succeed on the very next attempt, and the trophy should pop. Do not force it: it will likely come naturally during a normal playthrough. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.tip: Succeed on your second try — it comes naturally.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida — the description reads like a UFO or weird-encounter moment. Explore the odd corners of the map at night and keep an eye on the sky; when the strange event happens, the trophy pops. This is the game's mystery trophy, so enjoy the hunt. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.tip: Witness something strange — explore odd places at night.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl your target over. Line up a slow pass beside a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops on the hit. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.tip: Melee drive-by: swing from a moving vehicle.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your laundering contacts and convert them to clean cash. The total is cumulative, so keep laundering after every big score. PSN tracks the count toward $250,000. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.tip: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through contacts.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars, food — every shop purchase counts toward the total, so this climbs on its own as you gear up through the game. If it lags, buy big-ticket items you actually want rather than wasting cash. PSN tracks the count toward $100,000. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.tip: Spend $100,000 in shops — it climbs as you gear up.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress and earn money — buy each one when it appears on the property market, and keep the cash ready so a new listing never has to wait. PSN tracks the count toward 8. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.tip: Buy all 8 garage properties.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone, add a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until ten are registered — any ten vehicles count, so use the ones you already drive. PSN tracks the count toward 10. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.tip: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
